description: Unique identifier of the patient who owns the underlying record. Mandatory on every chunk; used as the hard isolation/filter key.
Identifier of the source document (medical timeline, lab report, imaging report, etc.) the chunk was extracted from.
Unique identifier of this specific chunk within the document.
ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the clinical event described in the chunk. If a chunk spans multiple dates, the earliest date in the chunk is stored and is_multi_event is set to true.
Full name of the treating/recording clinician for the event(s) in the chunk.
Type of the clinical record described in the chunk (encounter / prescription / lab_result / imaging_report; mixed or unknown for fallback chunks).
Authorization scope required to view this chunk (self / delegate / clinician_care_relationship).
True if a single chunk mixes more than one clinical event/record_type (a risk indicator for fixed-token chunking).
Number of tokens in the chunk text, used for token-efficiency accounting.
